recipe.name: Sigillum / Delft clay / Silver 925
recipe.calibration_note: Starting values; verify with shop trials

manufacturing.bench_notes: Factory 005 Rosette through the sand master, z = 0 parting, opposed z withdrawal. The cheek arcades and shoulder roundels are struck along the pull and cast. The table pours plain: after the pour the seal is cut at the bench as mirrored intaglio with drafted walls (the quatrefoil field 0.30 deep at 15 deg, the fleur-de-lis 0.70 at 12 deg, the legend 0.40), all centred on the table's centre on the parting line. Polish the table and cheeks; leave the seal's floors satin so a wax impression lifts clean.
